The role asks for RAG over internal documents and a way to evaluate retrieval. I did that in DocSearch.

I compared two kinds of search on 150 hand-written questions. Hybrid retrieval lifted recall from 0.61 to 0.78. I measure before I change anything.

I wrote the service in Python with FastAPI and shipped it with Docker. The tests run on every change.
